<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/annual-audit">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FinalAuditReport" name="Final audit report"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_AnnualAudit">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Multinational Company" processRef="Process_AnnualAudit"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ExecutiveBoard" name="Executive Board"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FinalReport" name="Distribute final report" sourceRef="Task_DistributeReport" targetRef="Participant_ExecutiveBoard" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditReport"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_AnnualAudit" name="Annual Audit Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_AnnualAudit">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditCoordinator" name="Audit Coordinator">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Audit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyRegional</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegionalOffice" name="Regional Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareStatements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ComplianceTeam" name="Compliance Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CentralAuditTeam" name="Central Audit Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReviewMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Discrepancies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HighRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InvestigationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DataAnalysis</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductInterviews</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SiteVisits</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InvestigationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InvestigationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportReviewMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResubmitReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FinalActionsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FinalActionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditDirector" name="Audit Director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Audit" name="Annual audit initiated"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyRegional" name="Notify regional office"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelStart" name="Begin concurrent work"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareStatements" name="Prepare financial statements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherDocuments" name="Gather necessary documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" name="Check for regulatory updates"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Preparation and compliance check complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewMerge" name="Continue submission review"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewSubmission" name="Review submission"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Discrepancies" name="Discrepancies found?" default="Flow_NoDiscrepancies"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestClarifications" name="Request clarifications"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideClarifications" name="Provide clarifications"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" name="Evaluate all risk areas"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" name="Evaluate financial risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" name="Evaluate operational risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" name="Evaluate compliance risks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin" name="All risk areas evaluated"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HighRisk" name="High risk identified?" default="Flow_NoHighRisk"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InvestigationSplit" name="Conduct investigation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DataAnalysis" name="Perform data analysis"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductInterviews" name="Conduct interviews"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SiteVisits" name="Conduct site visits"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InvestigationJoin" name="Investigation activities complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InvestigationMerge" name="Continue after risk assessment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompileReport" name="Compile audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportReviewMerge" name="Submit report for review"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewReport" name="Review audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Report approved?" default="Flow_RevisionsRequired"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateReport" name="Update report"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResubmitReport" name="Resubmit report"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalActionsSplit" name="Distribute and archive report"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DistributeReport" name="Distribute final report" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditReport"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveReport" name="Archive final report"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin" name="Distribution and archiving complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AuditClosed" name="Audit process closed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Audit" targetRef="Task_NotifyRegional"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRegional" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelStart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_PrepareStatements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_PrepareStatements" targetRef="Task_GatherDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_GatherDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarifications" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ReviewSubmission" targetRef="Gateway_Discrepancies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Discrepancies" name="Discrepancies found" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancies" targetRef="Task_RequestClarifications">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${discrepanciesFound}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarificationResponse" sourceRef="Task_RequestClarifications" targetRef="Task_ProvideClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDiscrepancies" name="No discrepancies" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancies" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin" targetRef="Gateway_HighRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HighRisk" name="High risk identified" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${highRiskIdentified}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoHighRisk" name="No high risk identified" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationSplit" targetRef="Task_DataAnalysis"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationSplit" targetRef="Task_ConductInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisit" name="Site visits are required" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationSplit" targetRef="Task_SiteVisits">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${siteVisitRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_DataAnalysis" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_ConductInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_SiteVisits" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationMerge" targetRef="Task_CompileReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_CompileReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_ResubmitReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportReviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Task_ReviewReport" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Gateway_FinalActionsSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reportApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RevisionsRequired" name="Revisions required" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_UpdateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_UpdateReport" targetRef="Task_ResubmitReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_DistributeReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_ArchiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="Task_DistributeReport" targetRef="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_35" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveReport" targetRef="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActionsJoin" targetRef="End_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
